title: The Gumball Chronicles

ai_content.desc_en: The Gumball Chronicles is a short series derived from the famous series The Amazing World of Gumball, where it showcases clips from previous episodes along with some new content. This show brings together a talented cast of characters, each with their own unique personalities and quirks, creating a hilarious and entertaining experience.
